subject: Maths
cover: Real Numbers — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Euclid's division lemma
slides.sub: For a, b ∈ ℤ, b ≠ 0: a = bq + r, 0 ≤ r < |b|

slides.headline: HCF via Euclidean algorithm
slides.sub: Repeat a = bq + r until r = 0; last non-zero r is HCF

slides.headline: Fundamental theorem
slides.sub: Every composite n = product of primes (unique factorization)

slides.headline: LCM × HCF
slides.sub: For a, b: a × b = HCF(a,b) × LCM(a,b)

slides.headline: Irrational proof
slides.sub: √p irrational if p is prime (contrapositive: assume rational, derive contradiction)

slides.headline: Degree of polynomial
slides.sub: Highest power of variable; e.g. 3x² + 2x + 1 has degree 2

slides.headline: Factor theorem
slides.sub: (x - a) is factor of p(x) ⟺ p(a) = 0

slides.headline: Sum & product of roots (quadratic)
slides.sub: ax² + bx + c: sum = -b/a, product = c/a

slides.headline: Relationship roots & coefficients
slides.sub: For αβ roots: α + β = -b/a, αβ = c/a

subject: Maths
cover: Linear Equations — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Graphical solution
slides.sub: Plot both lines; intersection = solution (x, y)

slides.headline: Algebraic: substitution
slides.sub: Express one variable, substitute in other; solve

slides.headline: Algebraic: elimination
slides.sub: Multiply equations to cancel variable, add/subtract

slides.headline: Consistency check (a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0)
slides.sub: a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂ → unique sol; a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ → no sol

slides.headline: Dependent equations
slides.sub: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ → infinitely many solutions

subject: Maths
cover: Quadratic Equations — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Discriminant (Δ)
slides.sub: Δ = b² - 4ac; Δ > 0: 2 roots; Δ = 0: 1 root; Δ < 0: no real roots

slides.headline: Nature of roots
slides.sub: Δ = perfect square → rational; Δ < 0 → imaginary

slides.headline: Completing the square
slides.sub: ax² + bx + c = a(x + b/2a)² - (b²/4a) + c

subject: Maths
cover: Arithmetic Progressions — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: AP definition
slides.sub: Sequence where a_n - a_(n-1) = d (constant common difference)

slides.headline: Common difference
slides.sub: d = a₂ - a₁ (or any a_n - a_(n-1))

slides.headline: Similarity criterion: SAS
slides.sub: Two sides proportional + included angle equal → similar

slides.headline: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales)
slides.sub: Line || to side divides other sides proportionally

slides.headline: Pythagoras theorem
slides.sub: In right △: a² + b² = c² (c = hypotenuse)

slides.headline: Converse Pythagoras
slides.sub: If a² + b² = c² then △ is right-angled

slides.headline: Area ratio & similarity
slides.sub: If triangles ~ with ratio k, area ratio = k²

subject: Maths
cover: Coordinate Geometry — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Basic ratios
slides.sub: sin θ = opp/hyp, cos θ = adj/hyp, tan θ = opp/adj

slides.headline: Reciprocal ratios
slides.sub: cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ

slides.headline: Complementary angles
slides.sub: sin(90°-θ) = cos θ, cos(90°-θ) = sin θ, tan(90°-θ) = cot θ

slides.headline: Ratio relationships
slides.sub: tan θ = sin θ/cos θ, cot θ = cos θ/sin θ

subject: Maths
cover: Applied Trigonometry — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Line of sight
slides.sub: Angle of elevation/depression measured from horizontal

slides.headline: Angle of elevation
slides.sub: Above horizontal (e.g. eye to top of building)

slides.headline: Angle of depression
slides.sub: Below horizontal (e.g. cliff edge to ship)

slides.headline: Height/distance formula
slides.sub: Use tan θ = opposite/adjacent; solve for unknown

slides.headline: Multiple angles problem
slides.sub: Two angles from one/two points; use ratio method

slides.headline: Clinometer/theodolite setup
slides.sub: Measure angle of elevation, apply tan rule

slides.headline: Tangent definition
slides.sub: Line touches circle at exactly one point

slides.headline: Radius ⊥ tangent
slides.sub: Tangent at point ⊥ radius at that point

slides.headline: Tangents from external point
slides.sub: Two tangents from external point are equal in length

slides.headline: Chord properties
slides.sub: Equal chords equidistant from center; perpendicular from center bisects chord

slides.headline: Angles in same segment
slides.sub: Angles subtended by same chord at circumference are equal

slides.headline: Angle at center
slides.sub: Angle at center = 2 × angle at circumference (same arc)

subject: Maths
cover: Circle Areas — every Class 10 formula (save this)

slides.headline: Annulus (ring) area
slides.sub: A = π(R² - r²) (R = outer, r = inner radius)

slides.headline: Cuboid: surface & volume
slides.sub: SA = 2(lb + bh + hl), V = l × b × h

slides.headline: Cone: surface & volume
slides.sub: CSA = πrl, TSA = πr(r+l), V = ⅓πr²h (l = slant height)

slides.headline: Median
slides.sub: Middle value when data sorted; for grouped: l + ((n/2 - F)/f) × w
